|game_text=Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a non-lightsaber weapon (without “lost” in game text) here. If a battle was just initiated, may deploy weapon here on a participating card. Return weapon here at end of weapons segment (if possible), if it leaves table, or at end of battle. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the image is its release-sheet slip. The later errata version is [[Imperial Stockpile (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text); the Players Committee card image prints that text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 December 2010"), page 2, slip 5 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a non-lightsaber weapon (without “lost” in game text) here. If a battle was just initiated, may deploy weapon here on a participating card. Return weapon here at end of weapons segment (if possible), if it leaves table, or at end of battle. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Imperial_Stockpile.png]]) prints it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Stockpile (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (from 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, to 11 January 2013) has “Return weapon here … at end of battle, or if it is about to leave table, be stolen, or become inactive.” instead of “if it leaves table, or at end of battle.” (with the ▲ and the [Immune to Alter] icon written out)<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref>; the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 28) prints it<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=28, page 28. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=28 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a non-lightsaber weapon (without “lost” in game text) here. If a battle was just initiated, may deploy weapon here on a participating card. Return weapon here at end of weapons segment (if possible), at end of battle, or if it is about to leave table, be stolen, or become inactive. [Immune to Alter]” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-imperialstockpile-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip print it. The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 28 January 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p598246">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 28 January 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=0#p598246 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
